shared_elements: upright freestanding stone shaft/stela as the decorated field
frontal human-like face carved in relief on the shaft
face rendered with eyes, nose and mouth in symmetrical frontal view
seated human figure beside the monument (in the scene)
justification: Both surfaces are upright monolithic shafts bearing a symmetrical frontal face in relief on the upper part of the stone, and both scenes incidentally include a hatted person seated at the monument's base. But the carving content differs enormously: A shows a single, extremely reduced face with plain unworked stone around it, while B shows a densely packed vertical stack of ornate masks framed by volutes, scrolls and rectangular sign-blocks covering every part of the shaft.
